name: Ammo Economy
description: The magazine, the reserve, and the reload — the three numbers that turn a shooter from infinite DPS into resource pressure. Split from combat.weapon_loadout on purpose: the loadout is declarative (what is equipped) while this owns mutable state (what is left), and mixing the two makes every swap a state migration bug. Reserve ammunition is an inventory concern, so when reserveSource is 'inventory' every reload draws through inventory.core_inventory and ammo pickups feed the same pool the rest of the game uses. Reload is interruptible by default because an uninterruptible reload in a cover shooter reads as a stun the player did not earn; a weapon swap cancels it and the partial magazine is kept, never rounded up.

inputs.name: magazineSize
inputs.description: Rounds held in the weapon. The magazine, not the reserve, is the pacing lever: it decides how long a fight can go before someone has to stop and be vulnerable.

inputs.name: startingReserve
inputs.description: Rounds outside the weapon at spawn when reserveSource is 'standalone'. Ignored when drawing from inventory — there the reserve is simply however many ammo items the player holds.

inputs.name: reserveSource
inputs.description: 'inventory' draws reloads from inventory.core_inventory so crafting and loot feed ammo; 'standalone' keeps a private counter for arena modes that want ammo decoupled from the item economy.

inputs.name: reloadTimeSeconds
inputs.description: Channel duration per reload. Per-weapon overrides arrive with the weapon profile on equip; this default exists so a bare component still produces a playable rhythm.

inputs.name: reloadInterruptible
inputs.description: Whether a swap or dash cancels the channel. Cancelling keeps the old magazine state — an interrupted reload never refunds rounds, which is what keeps the decision to reload a risk.

outputs.name: magazineAmmo
outputs.description: Rounds in the weapon right now. The HUD reads this; combat.projectile_system never does — it fires on request and lets the rejection event do the talking.

outputs.name: reserveAmmo
outputs.description: Rounds available for future reloads. In inventory mode this is a live count of matching ammo items, not a cached number.

outputs.name: isReloading
outputs.description: True for the reload channel. Fire requests during the channel are rejected by the economy, not queued, because a queued shot after a reload reads as input lag.
